name: p5.js
role: Generative 2D and WebGL sketches written as a pure function of time and seed
summary: Creative-coding library with the broadest beginner-to-expert API for procedural 2D, simple WebGL, noise and randomness. In VCR a sketch runs with noLoop and redraws for the time the harness asks for, resetting its seeds every frame, so particle fields, flow fields and noise textures capture deterministically.
use_when: Procedural backgrounds, particles, flow fields and noise-driven abstracts
Over Pts or canvas-sketch when you want the largest API and example base
Quick 2D experiments where a scene graph would be overhead
Data-driven abstract visuals from a small JSON input
avoid_when: Real 3D with lights, materials and loaders: Three.js
Vector output that a designer must edit afterwards: SVG with GSAP
Sprite-heavy scenes with thousands of objects: PixiJS

facets.one_line: noLoop, redraw from t, reset noiseSeed and randomSeed per frame
Centred origin, per-frame lights, loaded fonts
Seeded Perlin noise as the deterministic motion source

evidence.result: 90 alpha frames at 1280x720; shuffled order matches sequential
